measurements.Scope: Explicit lighting-only native probe: actual tray, native editor, uniform worker and observed descendants. Existing stock services/kernel drivers excluded; unrelated apply/actions disabled. Not final feature, input, optical or RAM acceptance.
measurements.MetricNote: Sum of observed process working-set high-waters and sampled private committed bytes. Shared pages can be counted more than once. Descendants discovered once per second; short-lived processes and UDP/DNS traffic are not covered. Peak paged memory is an additional conservative metric.
